subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — schedule your intro
body:
From: signup@redwood.ai
To: Emma Park <emma@alderlabs.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — next steps

Thanks for signing up for the Redwood developer trial!

What happens next:
- Quick intro: pick a 30-minute slot with one of our SDR engineers to walk through your use case.
- Self-serve: if you want to jump straight in, use the links below — we surface the best model configs for inference-heavy workloads.

Schedule a 30-min intro: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min?cid=ald-118
Access docs & quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart

If you attached an integration plan during signup, we included it below.

[Attachment: trial-instructions.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

--
Redwood Inference Team
no-reply@redwood.ai

----- Original Message -----
From: Emma Park <emma@alderlabs.com>
To: signup@redwood.ai
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:28:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — next steps

Thanks — the onboarding flow looks great. I can do Wednesday 11/19 at 10:00 AM PT for the walkthrough. If that slot is still open for your SDR, please add it. Also I have a short list of questions about data retention and VPC options.

Best,
Emma
Senior Platform Engineer, Alder Labs

----- Original Message -----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma@alderlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:12:03 -08:00
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — schedule your intro

Emma — great to meet you and welcome aboard. Karthik (cc'd) is our SDR engineer who'll run the 30-minute technical orientation and help map Redwood to your integration checklist.

Short plan:
- You chose 11/19 at 10:00 AM PT — Karthik, can you confirm and send the calendar invite?
- Agenda (attached): 10min discovery, 15min demo (runtime + config suggestions), 5min next steps and limits.
- Pre-reads: trial-instructions.pdf has provisioning steps; if you want us to provision a demo endpoint ahead of time, say the model size and expected tokens/session.

If you prefer a different time, let us know and we’ll swap.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Platform Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

[Attachment: demo-agenda.md (Markdown, 3KB)]

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma@alderlabs.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — schedule your intro

Emma — confirmed and invite sent.

Meeting: Redwood Intro — Alder Labs
When: Wed, Nov 19, 2025 · 10:00 – 10:30 AM Pacific Time (US & Canada)
Where: Zoom (link included in calendar invite)
Agenda: discovery → demo → next steps (see attached agenda).

Quick logistics for the call:
- If you can drop one sample prompt or expected tokens/session in the event notes, I’ll bring suggested batching/quantization settings so the initial endpoint is close to production cost targets.
- If Alder Labs requires VPC or a dedicated pool for the trial, flag that early and Mina will route the procurement checklist.

See you then — looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
SDR Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
